rationale: The canonical MultiCNNPolicy docstring and implementation establish distinct state/features and button-history CNN branches. The final qualified project claim licenses only the two-branch architecture component; it does not assert visual image processing, PPO/reward training, management scale or budget ownership. Broader DRL and prospective-demo assertions were rejected, and the valid architecture received independent fallback review after those rejections. Exact source/span matches the reviewed J05/J14 architecture evidence.
